old-south-church-boston.assessment: Old South Church in Boston is a historic UCC (United Church of Christ) congregation. The UCC denomination has broadly progressive theology including affirming stances on same-sex marriage and ordination of women. While historically significant, the current theological trajectory of UCC churches typically does not align with conservative evangelical convictions. Evaluate carefully.
